description: CO-Benefits Risk Assessment (COBRA) Health Impacts Screening and Mapping Tool is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by EPA, U.S. Environmental Protection Agency. Analysts, environmental agencies, energy officials, and transportation planners can use this tool to recognize the health benefits of clean energy policies. Outcomes are monetized, giving users a way to perform a simple cost/benefit analysis for their region. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Air Quality. Assets: Economy, Energy and Utilities, Transportation and Mobility. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
